notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 - new "Clock Stopped" Trial Settings option
notes.content:
Patch 1.1.0

New Feature: Added the Trial Settings "Clock Stopped", making the count down timer disabled unless the player falls onto traps or when they are hit by enemies. This option makes the game more acessible for people who don't want the stress of a timer, and when paired with other settings such as no enemies and no traps, the game essentially becames a vanilla "Anomaly detection" type game.
Also, this option provides more flexibility for players who are interested in doing the side quests as well, such as solving each one of the trials big riddles or finding mini arbiters.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.12
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.12 Notes:

Features:

[list]
[*] Added "Reduce Bright Effects" Accessibility option for people who have issues with bright flashes or other photosensitivity issues.
[*] Added the text "Time's Up!" when losing from reaching 0 seconds during ritual phase.
[/list]

Balance:
[list]
[*] Moved one enemy spawner further away from the tunnel on Extreme Campaign
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Changed the Ritual music and Trial win or fail to the correct Music Category, so they should now work with the music volume slider.
[*] Changed the death cinematic sounds to the SFX Category, so they should now work with the SFX volume slider.
[/list]
